_note: The book prints plaques, signs and quotations in shaded boxes with a faint map behind them. The PDF gives each box's text in the middle of whatever column text comes next, after a map-pin glyph and the background label '‘Ena Rd.'. Each entry lifts one box out of the stop where the parser put it, rejoins the sentence it cut in two, and puts the box where the book prints it. 'box_to' is the box's last words; 'place' is the block (by its first words) the box follows ('after') or comes before ('before'). Checked against the printed pages given. Built by scripts/build_data.py (apply_box_fixes).
